capital.evidence_quote: Belmopan is the purpose-built capital city of Belize, established after Hurricane Hattie

currency.evidence_quote: The Belize Dollar (BZD) is pegged to the US Dollar at exactly 2 BZD = 1 USD; USD is accepted everywhere

timezone.evidence_quote: Belize operates year-round on Central Standard Time UTC-6 without daylight saving changes

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply across Belize is 110V/220V dual voltage 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout Belize is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Outlets accommodate US Type A and B plugs, with British Type G three-pin sockets in older establishments

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police assistance throughout Belize

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or BERT (Belize Emergency Response Team) +501 223-3292 for medical dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 or local fire station numbers for emergency fire services

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency number operational nationwide

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism Police Unit (TPU) headquarters in Belize City operates at +501 227-2420

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Belize City güney kesiminde çete suçları nedeniyle dikkatli olunmalıdır; Ambergris Caye, Caye Caulker ve Placencia tatil adaları son derece güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution due to gang activity in south Belize City; the Cayes and reef resort areas are very safe.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht im Süden von Belize City; die Cayes (Caye Caulker, San Pedro) sind sichere Urlaubsinseln.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте осмотрительность в Белиз-Сити; курортные острова Амбергрис-Кей и Кей-Колкер спокойны и безопасны.
advisory_headline.es: Actúe con mayor cautela en el sur de Ciudad de Belice; los Cayos y arrecifes son zonas turísticas muy seguras.

regional_warnings.area: Belize City south side (south of Haulover Creek Canal)

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Belize reach approximately 34.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in tourist towns measure 55.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digi (BTL) and SMART provide 4G mobile data packages. English is the official language. US dollars are universally accepted at the fixed exchange rate of 1 USD = 2 BZD everywhere in Belize.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: US dollars are accepted across the nation at the official fixed 2:1 peg

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 40%), Protestantism (approx. 32%), with Garifuna and Maya cultural heritage
religion.evidence_quote: Belize is multicultural with English as the official language and rich Garifuna drumming traditions

festivals.value: Garifuna Settlement Day (Nov 19), September Celebrations & Carnival, San Pedro Lobster Fest
festivals.evidence_quote: Garifuna Settlement Day marks the 1832 arrival of the Garinagu people with drumming and parades

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Touching or standing on living coral reefs in the Belize Barrier Reef reserve is strictly prohibited and subject to marine conservation fines. Sunscreen used when snorkeling must be biodegradable/reef-safe. English is universally spoken.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Damaging or harvesting coral in marine protected areas is prohibited under the Fisheries Act

tipping.value: Tipping 10-15% is customary in restaurants and resorts. Boat captains and diving instructors are typically tipped $10-20 per person per excursion.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10-15% gratuity is standard for good restaurant and guide service
